$comment: Per-product demo activation for the ADS demo portal. Values: preparing (default, 'Demo being prepared'), open ('Open demo', links to the reviewed catalogue.json demoDestination), unavailable (clear unavailable state, no link). Switch a product to open only after the operator has confirmed the deployed application, HTTPS and ADS sign-in for it. Destinations are never read from this file. A missing or invalid file keeps every product preparing. Commerce keeps its existing catalogue demoUrl and is not managed here.
